summary: Moved all date/time parsing into deskstats/timeparse.py per the guide; other modules delegate to it, existing tests pass and tests/test_timeparse.py was added. Quirks kept as-is (e.g. site/sheet/ticket naive-time differences, two-digit years, DMY int() leniency); only change: out-of-range epochs/24:00 at date.max now raise ValueError instead of OverflowError.
